ddl.name: integrations_refresh_claim_check
ddl.value: ("refresh_state" = 'refreshing' and "refresh_claim_id" is not null and "refresh_claimed_at" is not null) or ("refresh_state" <> 'refreshing' and "refresh_claim_id" is null and "refresh_claimed_at" is null)

ddl.name: oauth_authorization_attempts_integration_check
ddl.value: ("mode" = 'create' and "integration_id" is null) or ("mode" = 'reconnect' and "integration_id" is not null)

ddl.name: workflow_event_inbox_settled_check
ddl.value: ("status" = 'pending' and "settled_at" is null and "error" is null) or ("status" = 'delivered' and "settled_at" is not null and "error" is null) or ("status" = 'failed' and "settled_at" is not null and "error" is not null)

ddl.name: workflow_execution_schedule_subject_check
ddl.value: ("kind" = 'run' and "execution_id" is not null and "inbox_id" is null and "workflow_id" is null and "cron" is null and "time_zone" is null) or ("kind" = 'delivery' and "inbox_id" is not null and "execution_id" is null and "workflow_id" is null and "cron" is null and "time_zone" is null) or ("kind" = 'cron' and "workflow_id" is not null and "cron" is not null and "time_zone" is not null and "execution_id" is null and "inbox_id" is null)

ddl.name: workflow_execution_schedule_lease_check
ddl.value: ("state" = 'leased' and "owner_token" is not null and "lease_expires_at" is not null and "worker_id" is not null) or ("state" <> 'leased' and "owner_token" is null and "lease_expires_at" is null and "worker_id" is null and "running_step_id" is null and "running_node_id" is null)

ddl.name: workflow_executions_entity_identity_pair_check
ddl.value: ("entity_type" is null and "entity_id" is null) or ("entity_type" is not null and "entity_id" is not null)

ddl.name: workflow_executions_schedule_check
ddl.value: ("scheduled_for" is null and "schedule_cron" is null and "schedule_time_zone" is null) or ("scheduled_for" is not null and "schedule_cron" is not null and "schedule_time_zone" is not null and "start_source" = 'schedule')

ddl.name: workflow_executions_termination_check
ddl.value: ("termination_kind" is null and "termination_requested_at" is null and "termination_reason" is null and "termination_node_id" is null) or ("termination_kind" = 'cancel' and "termination_requested_at" is not null and "termination_reason" is null and "termination_node_id" is null) or ("termination_kind" = 'exit' and "termination_requested_at" is not null and "termination_reason" in ('entity_condition_not_met', 'entity_not_found') and "termination_node_id" is not null)

ddl.name: workflow_wait_states_wake_check
ddl.value: ("status" <> 'waiting' or "wake" is null) and ("status" <> 'resuming' or "wake" is not null)
